description: Find published Spanish company changes and commercial registry notices (empresas y actos societarios): incorporations, appointments, resignations, capital, address changes and dissolutions in BORME.

interface.longDescription: Research published changes to Spanish companies with links to the original commercial registry notices. Search a company name, province and date range of up to seven days in BORME, Spain’s Official Commercial Registry Gazette. Review matching notices for incorporations, appointments and resignations, registered address or capital changes, corrections and dissolutions when present in the source. See the publication date, available registration details and which editions were checked. This is a lookup of published notices, not a complete company report, annual accounts or balance-sheet service, credit score or registry certificate.
